subject: Private deployment packaging and support banding — GreenVale Health
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@greenvalehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@greenvalehealth.com>, Legal <legal@greenvalehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment packaging for GreenVale Health — initial sizing

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. GreenVale is leaning toward a private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for our clinical inference stack — primary reasons are PHI controls and on-site latency. Before we get legal involved, can you send a short commercial breakdown for: 1) pilot (3-month) pricing; 2) production packaging (annual commit) including platform fee, operator licensing model (per-site vs per-GPU), and typical SRE retainer tiers; and 3) any onboarding / concierge credits you might offer for first deployments?

Attached is a draft SOW with our rough sizing (20 inference nodes, ~120 tokens per request average, 500k tokens/day) — this is preliminary. We also have two procurement questions up front: 1) can platform fee be amortized over a year or capitalized; 2) do you provide a limited SLA exception window for pilot customers?

If useful, our procurement lead (procurement@greenvalehealth.com) and legal are CC'd. Hoping for a short bulleted response so we can review internally.

Best,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Infrastructure
GreenVale Health

Attachment: GVH_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@greenvalehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@greenvalehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment packaging for GreenVale Health — initial sizing

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. High level options based on the sizing in your draft:

1) Pilot (3 months) — Starter Pilot
- Platform fee: $0 (waived for first 3 months)
- Operator licensing: site-based license, up to 5 operator seats included
- Support: Standard SRE retainer response (business hours)
- Onboarding: one week remote onboarding + playbook (no concierge)
- Notes: Suitable to validate latency / correctness without long-term commitment

2) Production (annual commit) — Standard Package
- Platform fee: $18,000 / month (covers control plane, telemetry, and baseline observability)
- Operator licensing: per-site license $6,000 / site / month (or node-based alternative if you prefer per-GPU)
- Support tiers: Standard (8x5 response) included; Premium (24x7 with on-call) add-on at $10k / month
- Onboarding: discounted concierge option available (see below)

3) Enterprise (committed) — Anchor Package
- Platform fee: 15% discount with 12-month commit (applies to platform fee only)
- Operator licensing: volume pricing available at >5 sites/nodes
- Support: Premium included for larger commits; custom SLA options possible

Concierge onboarding (optional add-on)
- 4-week on-site or remote engagement, knowledge-transfer, runbook codify: list price $45k
- Typical concession: $30k credit for 12-month commitments > $500k ARR

Notes on procurement questions:
- Platform fee amortization: Yes, we can invoice platform fee monthly or provide a single annual invoice for capitalization — we typically do monthly by default but can accommodate annual invoicing for accounting.
- Pilot SLA: We can provide an SLA carveout with an elevated response during the pilot window but full SLA credits require a committed package.

See attached SKU workbook for a modeled cost table (rows: pilot / standard / enterprise; columns: platform fee, operator license, support, onboarding). If this looks aligned, I can loop in Marissa for commercial flexibility and Mateo for billing cadence.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Strategic Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Private_Packaging_SKU.xlsx (XLSX, stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment packaging for GreenVale Health — internal price posture

Hannah — internal note / commercial suggestion before we reply to procurement:

I think GreenVale is a classic pilot-to-commit motion. Proposed concession posture:
- Offer a $30k concierge onboarding credit (applied against SOW / professional services) if they sign a 12-month anchor (>= $480k TCV).
- Reduce platform fee by 15% for the first 12 months (then revert to list unless they extend).
- Operator license: propose per-site license for predictability but add a clause for a node-based true-up at 6 months.
- SLA: allow elevated pilot response (SLA-lite) and commit to full SLA only after production go-live and final SOW sign-off.

Mateo — if we do the $30k credit and 15% platform reduction, can finance accept the cap table on refunds/credits (i.e., one-time credit applied to first invoice)? Also confirm whether we can do annual invoicing on platform fee for their accounting preference.

If finance is good and you approve, Hannah can send a short commercial counter that leaves legal out until they confirm commitment.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Solutions & Commercials
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@greenvalehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@greenvalehealth.com>, Legal <legal@greenvalehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-21T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment packaging for GreenVale Health — initial offer and next steps

Oliver / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on your SOW and the internal posture above, here's a compact commercial offer you can take to procurement / legal:

Summary offer (pilot -> production path)
- Pilot (3 months): platform fee waived; site license available; standard support included.
- Production (12-month anchor):
  - Platform fee: $15,300 / month (15% discount applied to our $18k list) for first 12 months
  - Operator licensing: $6,000 / site / month; node-based true-up at month 6 if usage significantly exceeds the draft sizing
  - Concierge onboarding credit: $30,000 credit applied to onboarding professional services upon signature of a 12-month SOW (non-refundable credit applied to first SOW invoice)
  - Support: Premium response (24x7) is available as add-on or included for committed deals > $500k; otherwise Standard included

Billing options
- We can invoice platform fee monthly (default) or provide one annual invoice to support capitalization — please indicate preferred cadence and we will reflect that in the SOW/invoice schedule.

SLA / pilot note
- We will provide an elevated pilot response window (faster on-call routing) for the duration of the pilot. Full SLA credits and financial remedies will be included once the production SOW is executed.

Attachments included: GVH_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (your draft with our redlines suggested) and Redwood_Private_Packaging_SKU.xlsx (cost model).

Next steps
1) Please confirm: preferred billing cadence (monthly vs annual) and whether the $30k concierge credit + 15% platform reduction for year one is acceptable.
2) If yes, we will produce a short form SOW + commercial summary and route to legal and finance for DocuSign.
3) If procurement prefers, we can provide a milestone-based invoice schedule tied to pass/fail of pilot milestones.

DocuSign preview (commercial summary): https://app.docusign.com/signing/GVH-2026-offer-12345

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through the options.

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Strategic Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: GVH_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, redline), Redwood_Private_Packaging_SKU.xlsx (XLSX, modeled numbers)
